title: Luminex Multiplex Assay Protocol
author: Lori Haapanen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.56wg9fe

steps.title: Pre-wet Filter Plate
steps.instruction: Pre-wet the filter plate using assay buffer and vacuum.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 ul assay buffer to the filter plate
Agitate and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature (RT)
Remove fluid by vacuum

steps.title: Add Samples and Beads
steps.instruction: Dispense standards, controls, and samples into the filter plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 ul of standards, controls, assay buffer, samples, matrix serum, and beads to the appropriate wells

steps.title: Incubate Plate Overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate on a shaker at 4 degrees C.

substeps.instruction: Place filter plate on plate stand
Seal and wrap in foil
Agitate on a Titer Plate Shaker for 16-18 hours at 4 degrees C

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Remove fluid and wash the filter plate.

substeps.instruction: Remove fluid from the filter plate by vacuum
Wash the plate
Bolt well

steps.title: Add Detection Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate with detection antibody at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 ul of detection antibody to each well
Place filter plate on plate stand, seal, and wrap in foil
Agitate on a Titer Plate Shaker for 1 hour at RT

steps.title: Add Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin
steps.instruction: Add Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin without removing the detection antibody.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 ul of Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin to each well
Place filter plate on plate stand, seal, and wrap in foil
Agitate on the Titer Plate Shaker
Incubate for 30 mins at RT

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Remove fluid and wash the plate.

substeps.instruction: Remove the fluid by vacuum
Wash the plate
Bolt well

steps.title: Add Sheath Fluid
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate with Sheath Fluid.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 uls of Sheath Fluid to each well
Place on plate stand, seal, and wrap in foil
Agitate on the Titer Plate Shaker at RT for 5 minutes

steps.title: Configure Bio-Plex 200 Software
steps.instruction: Set up the assay parameters in the Bio-Plex 6.0 Manager software.

substeps.instruction: Add analytes, regions, standards, quality controls, and sample dilutions to the software

steps.title: Run Bio-Plex Analysis
steps.instruction: Run the plate on the Bio-Plex (Luminex) 200 system.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Calculate cytokine/chemokine concentrations from the median fluorescent intensity data.

substeps.instruction: Save and analyze data using a 5-parameter logistic or spline curve fitting method
Calculate concentrations in pg/ml
